description: ERC-8283 descriptor index schema, paired with the ERC-7730 v3 draft. This is the mutable '-next' draft: it changes frequently and without notice, and consumers MUST NOT rely on its stability — see ERC-8283 'Index file schemas and versioning'.

version.title: Schema version
version.description: Identical to the ERC-7730 descriptor schema version this index is paired with. A consumer MUST treat an index declaring a version it does not implement as invalid.

entries.title: Descriptor entries
entries.description: Maps each descriptorHash to the absolute URI of the ERC-7730 descriptor JSON file it identifies.

additionalProperties.title: Descriptor URI
additionalProperties.description: An absolute URI using the identical scheme that was used to successfully fetch this index.json itself — see 'Index file schemas and versioning' in ERC-8283. Never a relative path.
